errors: job: ValueError: Job exit code is not zero
scope: Sequential HTTP POST through complete response read; six requests per batch per process. No p99 estimate.
std_definition: Sample standard deviation (n-1), within one process; controls are never pooled.
rgb_definition: Decoded RGB uint8 channel values in [0,255]; differing pixel means any RGB channel differs; PSNR uses peak 255.
metrics_policy: Original raw and client-derived metrics are preserved verbatim. Corrected scalar times use explicit _ms/_s suffixes; only exact frozen Klein profiler stage names have a source-backed seconds rule. Unknown units remain unnormalized. Available arm observations do not qualify an incomplete A/B run.
known_client_normalization_bug: Frozen client treats all stage_durations as seconds; explicit *_ms values become erroneous *_ms_ms fields scaled by 1000. Offline corrections use raw response fields only.
